results.title: An exercise omitted from the latest session (no records) leaves its series untouched and never reads as deterioration
A partial exposure with fewer sets at the same load carries the same evidence as a full one (best performed set per exposure)
Legitimate evidence from a partial workout is preserved: a real workout in which only ONE exercise was done (all its sets logged) adds that exercise's exposure to its series, and nothing else
Skipped and not-reached exercises leave no record, so they cannot enter any series or be read as deterioration
Structured intensifier blocks never enter the evidence series, so an incomplete or smaller cluster cannot read as decline
Nothing in the engine raises a load automatically: the decision only reports OBSERVE / INVESTIGATE / ACT about a decline, and a single exposure never changes the program
